reference.question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的平均学分，取课程表学分，返回两年平均学分，对课程求平均。
reference.query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0), p2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2024) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2025) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2025;

predicted.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course;

rule_priority_excerpts: 本次问题的统一口径如下，优先于训练案例及不明确的知识描述：

2.公式算出来的比率类、平均值类结果，以及每股类指标，包括资产负债率、总资产收益率、市盈率、每股现金分红 DPS 等，用 ROUND(..., 2)。

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号为2的课程平均学分，返回两年平均值，保留两位小数，及差值，即2025减2024。

steps.query: WITH a AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE department_id=2), b AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE department_id=2) SELECT (b.avg_credit_2025-a.avg_credit_2024) AS diff_avg_credit_2025_minus_2024, a.avg_credit_2024, b.avg_credit_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 比较2024与2025课程学分不低于5的课程平均学分，并返回两年结果。

steps.query: SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_ge_5 FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>=3 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit_ge_5 FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>=3;
